title: Finch Notes Spent on Returned Merchandise — Finch Circle Loyalty Program Returns Desk Note
content:
The value of Finch Notes of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program applied to a purchase is never refunded to a card, cash or gift card.

**(a) Value of the new note — no longer in force for one return, see below.** When merchandise from a purchase paid in part with notes is returned and refunded, a new note, issued for the reason "return reinstatement", is issued for the note value attributable to the returned merchandise: the whole note value applied to the purchase when every item is returned, otherwise that value multiplied by the returned merchandise's share of the purchase's merchandise subtotal before notes, rounded half up to the cent.

**(b) What the new note names.** The new note names the return and the original note's code.

**(c) Expiry of the new note.** Its expiry date is the later of the original note's expiry date and the reinstatement date plus the tier's minimum validity of a reinstated note, less one day (the reinstatement date is day 1).

**(d) Once per return and note.** No reinstatement note has already been issued for the same return and original note, as the member's note history shows.

**(e) Afterwards.** A reinstated note that later expires follows the ordinary expiry rules.

**Status of clause (a).** Clause (a) is no longer in force for the refunded return of the member's purchase record most recently received back in returned status, when that merchandise was paid in part with Finch Notes: for that return one reinstatement note naming the return and the original note is issued for the value set by the current reinstatement basis, rounded half up to the cent. Clauses (b) to (e), including the expiry rule of clause (c) and the one reinstatement per return and original note, remain in force for every reinstatement.

The minimum validity of a reinstated note at each tier is that of the reinstated and courtesy note terms.

## Expiry under clause (c), worked (hypothetical)

| Original note expiry | Reinstatement date | Tier minimum validity | Reinstatement date plus validity less one day | New note expiry (the later) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 1 June | 14 days | 14 June | 30 June |
| 5 June | 1 June | 30 days | 30 June | 30 June |
| 20 May (already passed) | 1 June | 60 days | 30 July | 30 July |

## Points of judgement

- **Can the note value be put back on the member's card instead?** No. Note value applied to a purchase is never refunded to a card, cash or gift card.
- **Can a second reinstatement note be issued for the same return and the same original note?** No.

superseded_clauses: When merchandise from a purchase paid in part with notes is returned and refunded, a new note (issue_reason return_reinstatement) is issued for the note value attributable to the returned merchandise: the whole note value applied to the purchase when every item is returned, otherwise that value times the returned merchandise's share of the purchase's merchandise subtotal before notes, rounded half up to the cent.
